notes: From T8 to T26 the runner clicked for credits almost every click, hoarding 50 credits with Carmen/Tremolo installed and a full grip, never contesting the remote. It let Tomorrow's Headline score from Server 2 on T14 and Freedom of Information on T27 (installed T25, advanced T26) for the loss while sitting on 6 points.

Clean score-out from an iced Server 1 (Sericulture Expansion T3, Yagi-Uda T6, Sericulture T10, Flower Sermon T14) against a runner that never ran. Minor slack: T12 clicked twice for credits at 10+ credits instead of advancing Flower Sermon, and T7 was a pure credit turn.

Facechecked R&D on T3 with 1 credit and lost Buzzsaw to Ballista, then turtled with credit clicks T6-T8, T10, T13 up to 28 credits. On T12 it twice declined to steal SDS Drone Deployment from HQ, and on T13 it ignored the fresh Server 4 that scored Divested Trust on T14 for the corp win.

On T3 the corp spent all its money rezzing Wave, Ansel 1.0 and Ablative Barrier on R&D, so both HQ ice stayed unrezzed while HQ filled with Architect Deployment Test, two Project Ingatan and Megaprix. At 0 credits on T4-T5 it kept clicking to draw more agendas into the open HQ instead of building money to rez, and lost on T5.

Won, but with sloppy moments: a T1 HQ facecheck with no breaker lost Tread Lightly to Piranhas, a T6 Server 1 facecheck into Ping cost 2 clicks and 4 credits in tag removal, and on T9 (Jailbreak) and T11 (Concerto) it hit Piranhas with Sang Kancil installed and didn't break, eating net damage. On T16 it played Maintenance Access and then jacked out of the run, wasting the turn.

HQ's single ice was never rezzed, so Architect Deployment Test was taken from an open HQ on T1 and HQ stayed open all game, and T2/T6 were pure credit-clicking turns with agendas in hand. With the runner at 6 points on T8, it installed and advanced Méliès City Luxury Line in the Server 1 the runner had just broken (Hagen/Vertigo), and the runner stole it to win.

Efficient, aggressive win by T8: built Telework Contract and Sure Gamble economy, then broke Klevetnik with Gauss and paid through Grubber to take Kingmaking and two Remastered Editions out of Server 1. The only oddity was an early T1 HQ facecheck into Klevetnik.

After bouncing off Akhet on T1, the runner never contested Weyland's Server 1 again, and the corp scored there on T2, T5, T7, T9 and T13. The runner clicked for credits through T7-T8 and T10-T13 up to 30 credits with no new breaker, and ignored the advanced card in Server 3 (Tree Line) that scored on T14 for the loss.

The Urtica Cipher traps in Server 2/3 and the Hybrid Release fast-scores were good. But See How They Run went into a one-ice remote on T2 and was stolen, and Lotus Haze and Longevity Serum sat in an HQ guarded only by Semak-samun and were stolen T12/T14, while T6 and T10 were credit-clicking turns that ended in discards instead of scoring them from the 3-ice Server 1.

Won against a passive runner, but on T7-T9 it clicked for credits at 13-20 credits and discarded instead of advancing. On T11 Mitosis put Longevity Serum and Lotus Haze into naked Servers 7/8 with 2 counters each while the runner had 34 credits, which only worked because the runner didn't run.

It kept installing agendas one at a time into a Server 1 the rich runner (30-45 credits) broke cheaply with Gauss/Unity, losing Tomorrow's Headline on T13 and T15 and Embedded Reporting on T17, then Embedded Reporting again from Server 2 on T30. It also spent many 10-15 credit turns clicking for credits (T7-T12, T27), and the Oppo Research tags on T14/T21 were never punished.

Facechecked Akhet on HQ (T1) and Tree Line on R&D (T3) with no fitting breaker, then gave up on Server 1 after T7 while the corp scored there on T8, T9, T11 and T13. T12-T17 were spent drawing, clicking credits and clearing Trickster Taka tags, and it didn't challenge SDS Drone Deployment (installed T17) before it scored T18 for the loss.

Rezzing Mestnichestvo for 5 on T1 left it broke, and on T6-T9 it spent a click and 2 credits each turn trashing Daily Casts, stuck at about 1 credit for many turns. Next Big Thing sat at 2 advancements behind a lone Ping from T5 to T12, and R&D gave up Embedded Reporting and Next Big Thing, though it still scraped out a T21 win.

A strong start (Longevity Serum stolen T4 and T10, Yagi-Uda T7) was followed by credit clicking on T11-T18 up to 46 credits while Regenesis scored from Server 2 on T17. On T21-T22 it ran into Anemone with no breaker and then into unbroken Karunā, going down to 1 card, so Fujii Asset Retrieval's 2 net damage on T23 flatlined it.

Steady R&D pressure, but on T6 it ran an unadvanced Server 1 card that had sat since T4 and lost Revolver to Urtica Cipher. From T8 to T11 it repeatedly ran R&D into unbroken Anemone, taking net damage each time, and on T11 it ran R&D again (18 credits) rather than contest the 2-advanced Fujii Asset Retrieval in Server 2 that won the game.

HQ's only ice was never rezzed all game, even with 10-20 credits on T11-T14, so the runner ran HQ freely about 12 times and took Project Ingatan on T1 and T11. After overspending on Ansel 1.0 on T3, it left the Ansel-installed Ingatan in Server 1 with unrezzed ice (stolen T4), then from T8 clicked for credits every turn with a 6-card HQ and installed nothing, losing to Méliès stolen from R&D on T14.

A coherent plan: break Afshar cheaply with Buzzsaw, run R&D every turn, build Leech counters and drip economy, then install Boi-tatá to break Ballista and take SDS Drone Deployment from HQ for the win on T13. One weakness: it left HQ alone from T2 to T12 while the corp discarded every turn.

On T3 it put Fujii Asset Retrieval behind a single Phoneutria, which doesn't end the run, and advanced it twice, so the runner stole 3 points. On T5 Cultivate trashed Project Yagi-Uda to Archives, where it was stolen T6, and Neurospike that turn did nothing. With the runner at 5 points, it installed Yagi-Uda in Server 1 on T7 at 0 credits after the Ivik rez, and it was stolen T8 for the loss.

A sound HB score-out: Ingatan behind Ansel 1.0 (the runner couldn't pay to steal), Méliès fast-advanced with Seamless Launch, and Superconducting Hub and a second Méliès from Server 1. Its one weakness was leaving R&D behind a lone Wave until T8, which let the runner multi-access and take two Megaprix and an Ingatan.

Excellent tempo: broke Klevetnik with Gauss to take Remastered Edition (T1) and Oracle Thinktank (T2), hammered unprotected R&D, took Remastered Edition from HQ on T5, and facechecked Funhouse on T7 for the winning Oracle Thinktank. The only slip was a third HQ run on T5 with 1 credit into Paywall.
